claims.claim: The new claimant has to make their own claim.
claims.quote: Tell the other person to make a new claim .
claims.note: To change who gets Child Benefit, the other person makes a new claim.

claims.claim: The new claimant needs a Government Gateway account.
claims.note: No source names Government Gateway or any other account needed to make the new claim.

claims.quote: your child’s birth or adoption certificate, if you have it
claims.note: The claim checklist asks for the child's birth or adoption certificate if available, but does not list the child's details as such.

claims.claim: The date of the change is needed.
claims.note: No source says the date of the change in claimant must be given.
